summary.text: Laurie Longtine is the Democratic candidate for the Wyoming House of Representatives, District 59, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on August 18, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Laurie Longtine was the Democratic nominee for Wyoming House of Representatives District 59 in 2014, 2016 and 2018, and lost each general election to Carl Loucks.
She received 36.5 percent of the vote in 2014, 30.5 percent in 2016 and 33.0 percent in 2018.
